verdict.rationale: Amplitude's docs say its SDKs share 'the same API surface across web, mobile, server, and game engines' with a shared identity/event model. They also mention browser auto-instrumentation, server-side ingestion via the HTTP V2 endpoint, a wizard that installs the right SDK for your framework, and named Flutter and React Native SDKs. That covers the core of the story across web, mobile and backend. A community report that integration is hard concerns implementation effort, not whether the SDKs exist, so it lowers confidence but does not create a dispute. Missing for 10: an explicit enumeration of supported languages and platforms (e.g., iOS, Android, Python, Java, Node) and independent hands-on corroboration that the SDKs work well.
